text: At its meeting of November 8, 2021, the Board of Directors, Toronto Parking Authority established an Audit and Risk Management Committee and adopted Terms of Reference for the Committee The purpose of this report is for the Audit and Risk Management Committee of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority to review its Terms of Reference (as noted in Attachment 1) and speak to the Committee's priorities (work plan) for 2022.
The Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
